description: This Dart source file defines an AppRouter class responsible for centralizing route management in a Flutter application. It handles static routes, dynamic routes with IDs for folders and documents, and provides fallback/error handling. The file also defines several placeholder widget classes for different screens.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: Contains static methods for route generation and path matching logic.

classes.name: _HomeScreen
classes.description: Placeholder widget for the home screen, displaying a folder overview.

classes.name: _FolderScreen
classes.description: Placeholder widget for displaying folder details based on ID.

classes.name: _DocumentScreen
classes.description: Placeholder widget for displaying document details based on ID.

classes.name: _ErrorScreen
classes.description: Widget shown when an invalid route or ID is encountered.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Main route generator that maps route names to corresponding screens, with support for dynamic IDs and error handling.

methods.name: _tryMatchWithId
methods.description: Checks if a route matches a pattern with an ID at the end and extracts the ID part.

methods.name: _extractId
methods.description: Extracts an integer ID from either a path tail or route arguments.

methods.name: _error
methods.description: Creates a route to an error screen with a specified message.
